text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No. I'm just looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I don't think I've changed at all since 
the old days. I'm still just an Umamusume 
who runs for herself, guided purely by 
what she loves."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Yet there were all of you, sharing in 
that dream, calling out to me, and 
supporting me."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It makes me realize that "Ines Fujin" is 
truly right here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, nice to meetcha~! I'm gonna run as 
selfishly as I want.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"So keep your eyes on me. And dream with 
me."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's been since last year's Arima, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...My heart is hot. It's burning. Ever 
since that day we competed in that race. 
And—

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan
text_block_list.text: Oguriin! Don't give up! Keep on running!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I am Oguri Cap. So... there's nothing to 
worry about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I swear I will never betray the 
expectations of everyone supporting me!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan! Ahaha, you're as strong as 
ever, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa there! Right back at you, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I don't plan on losing, though. After all, 
I am "Mejiro Ryan" too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Then, following everyone else's lead, I'll 
make a declaration! In today's race, the 
one who enjoys running the most will be 
ME!!
